note: ds-proposals/ and transitions/ are reference material kept in the repo and aren't imported by the app. src/Starfield.jsx draws on a canvas, which only takes colour strings, so it reads --star-cold, --star-warm and --ds-color-bg at mount and builds rgba() strings from them; the literals the audit sees are those templates. index.html only has the theme-color meta, which can't read a custom property and copies --ds-color-bg by hand.
